about: Each region's atmosphere class (classes.json), with the region research it rests on (region_note aspect and the water the built world gives it: cells by water kind on build 20261109T204317Z). The latitude band is not written here: tools/newworld/atmosphere.py measures it from the region's cells (classes.json bands). Sea regions take the class of the coast they wash, so a ship sees that coast's sky. docs/research/nw-02-walk5-atmosphere.md section 1.10.

banujha-basin: Hot and humid with steam rising off the water after rain; dark water between islets; 561 of its 902 cells are blackwater swamp.
ultherus-swamp: A grey-green maze of cattails and black water with a warm fog on the channels; 168 of 301 cells blackwater swamp.
tulmek-washes: Hot, humid and still, rain most days, brown water and mist; 331 cells blackwater swamp, the most of any region after Banujha.
blackwood: Long rains and fog over the bogs of a flooded hillscape; 267 blackwater and 772 pond cells (bog pools).
okuwun-rahei: Red mounds in green-grey marsh, pale lakes and brown creeks; 452 green-marsh cells, the most of any region.
nushara-bayou: A bayou of reed flats under heavy warm rain and low mist; 408 green-marsh cells.
lake-ulaish: A wide pale lake fringed with reed and delta marsh, squalls over open water and fog on the shores; 77 green-marsh cells round the lake.
barsaebica: Fen and sedge with reed beds and frequent rain; 236 pond and 83 green-marsh cells.
nha-enasa: A river plain with low banks, cut by channels, low cloud over the channels; rivers and streams are its water.
valley-of-storms: A rolling river plain with heavy rain and thunder; the river and its branches carry the causeways; 85 stream cells.
murkwood: A dark wood of huge roots: light comes green and dim, the air thick; morning fog and heavy rain; braided river arms (204 river cells).
arnesian-jungle: Humid lowland jungle and riverine forest under tall hardwoods; rain and fog the commonest weathers, sea fog on the coast.
chixathe-mesa: Mesa tops 60 to 110 m above the lowland, drier than the jungle, sharp winds, cold nights after hot days.
aunike-ridge: A ridge of firm ground above the marsh, breezy and a little drier, morning mist below and wide views.
hatandros-bight: Grey mud-flats and sandy points on the Padomaic shore, frequent rain and sea fog; 119 sea cells.
padomaic-ocean: The open eastern ocean: overcast and rainy with sea mist, bright on clear days.
benthic-yobesh: The south-eastern sea under a fixed grey overcast and a steady swell, off the Padomaic.
cape-percar: Sea mist from the Sea of Mists on the south coast, frequent rain, mangrove edges and salt creeks.
sea-of-mists: Warm and humid with mist most mornings; rain and thunderstorms are common.
kotherra-mangroves: Mangrove delta on Topal Bay: hot, frequent heavy rain, fog off the estuary at dawn.
topal-bay: A warm bay with sea breezes, sea fog and passing rain storms, facing the sunset.
althii-archipelago: Low islands under a steady sea wind and warm rain, paddies and mangrove coasts, sea on every side.
aphon-isle: A breezy island in Topal Bay with salt spray and sea mist.
skeith-isle: A windy rock island off the east coast, salt-laden and drier than the mainland, with sea fog and rain.
